## Summary

What does this change, and why? Link the motivation: the bug, the use case, or the discussion.

## Related issues

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (existing behavior or the public API changes)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Build, CI or tooling

## How was this tested?

Describe the tests you ran or added. Note anything that needs the libpostal model data (`just data`), since those tests
are skipped without it.

## Checklist

- [ ] `just check` passes (rustfmt, clippy, ruff and the Python tests)
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the change
- [ ] I updated the `## [Unreleased]` section of `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] I updated the docs under `docs/` if behavior or the public API changed
- [ ] The change is focused on one thing
- [ ] I agree that my contribution is licensed under the project's license (MIT OR Apache-2.0)

## Notes for reviewers

Anything that helps review: design trade-offs, follow-up work, benchmark numbers, or example output.
